messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: dedicated-pool elkwood-prod experiencing sustained tail latency >2000ms and 503 rate rise for 8m. Affected tenant: elkwood (VPC, dedicated). Paging on-call.
Maria Chen: seeing the same in the APM dashboard — p95 spiking on decode paths, queue depth up on worker-group-3.
Ajay Patel: on it. Do we know if this is steady traffic spike from tenant or a scheduler regression?
Samir Kapoor: from elkwood's metrics they're sending longer sequences + many concurrent requests. Their churn increased ~5x after their rollout at 09:04 UTC.
Jess Ortega: can we isolate to their dedicated pool? We should avoid global impact.
Quinn Rivera: yes, elkwood-prod is on its own GPU pool, but scheduler batching is shared by worker-group-3 which also serves a handful of small tenants.
Maria Chen: immediate mitigation: reduce elkwood's max_batch_tokens and lower prefetched concurrency. I can push a bespoke scheduler profile for them.
Ajay Patel: +1. What's a safe delta? Their usual max_batch_tokens is 4096 for throughput. Ramp down to 1024?
Samir Kapoor: suggest 1536 first — big drop might hurt throughput but will lower tail latency. We can iterate.
Jess Ortega: we also have KV cache pressure visible; frequent context cache churn. Might help to pin kv-cache for this tenant if possible.
Quinn Rivera: ops-bot, can you show the current scheduler knobs for elkwood-prod?
ops-bot: config dump for tenant elkwood-prod:
```
tenant: elkwood-prod
scheduler_profile: default-shared
max_batch_tokens: 4096
max_concurrency: 40
batch_time_ms: 12
kv_cache_ttl: 60s
```
Maria Chen: proposed temp override:
```
rctl apply-scheduler --tenant elkwood-prod --profile elkwood-bespoke --set max_batch_tokens=1536 --set max_concurrency=24 --set batch_time_ms=8
```
Ajay Patel: if we apply that, we should also enable the per-tenant fallback to smaller model variant if latency remains bad. Set routing.policy = prefer-low-latency?
Samir Kapoor: agreed. Also enable aggressive prefix caching for elkwood to reduce repeated decode tokens.
Jess Ortega: I can prepare the canary command and monitor dashboards. Maria, do you want me to run the apply?
Maria Chen: I'll run it — pushing now. Standby for rollout logs.
ops-bot: CHANGELOG: applying elkwood-bespoke profile to dedicated pool elkwood-prod (operator: Maria Chen)
ops-bot: PATCH /internal/scheduler/profiles elkwood-bespoke -> queued on controller-2
Maria Chen: applied to controller-2, controller-3 sequentially.
Ajay Patel: seeing a drop in p99 already from 3.1s to 1.6s for elkwood requests on worker-group-3. Good.
Quinn Rivera: their queue depth is down ~40%. 503s decreased.
Samir Kapoor: keep an eye for throughput regressions — ask elkwood to hold non-critical spikes.
Maria Chen: contacting CSM to notify Elkwood about emergency tuning. @Jess please include action items and ETA for re-eval.
Jess Ortega: pinged CSM (jordan) in PM. Notified Elkwood engineer (sarah.elk) via email + support ticket with reason and temporary profile details.
ops-bot: metric-alert: elkwood-prod 503-rate down to baseline; latency stable ~900ms p95.
Ajay Patel: next step: fine-tune max_batch_tokens upward in small steps and measure. If we can push to 2048 without tail regress, we regain throughput.
Samir Kapoor: also prepare a long-term fix: consider dedicated scheduler instance for elkwood with its own batching queue so other tenants unaffected. I'll open a RFC.
Maria Chen: logging the mitigation steps in the incident ticket. TL;DR: applied elkwood-bespoke profile (max_batch_tokens=1536, max_concurrency=24, batch_time_ms=8), enabled stronger prefix cache, notified customer.
Quinn Rivera: handing off to night on-call for watch. @Ajay you'll be primary for post-mortem?
Ajay Patel: I can own the post-mortem. Will collect traces, compare kernel selection changes, and correlate their rollout time.
Jess Ortega: night on-call ack: Quinn. I'll leave the alert policy loosened for 1h and a paging suppression for elkwood in the dedicated pool to avoid noise for the on-call.
Maria Chen: I'm going offline in 20m. Ajay, Samir — any blockers before I drop?
Samir Kapoor: none here. I have the RFC skeleton.
Ajay Patel: got it. Please include the exact rctl command in the ticket.
Maria Chen: done. rctl command + ops-bot logs attached.
ops-bot: NOTE: temporary profile elkwood-bespoke will auto-expire in 6h unless extended by ops.
Quinn Rivera: night on-call checklist: 1) Monitor p95/p99 2) Watch queue depth 3) If tail >2s for 5m re-run with max_batch_tokens=1024 and open pager.
Jess Ortega: added the checklist to the incident ticket.
Ajay Patel: I'll draft postmortem and recommended long-term solutions: per-tenant scheduler, more fine-grained kv-cache pinning, and a staged rollout guide for customers doing big sequence-length increases.
Maria Chen: thanks team. Handoff complete.
Samir Kapoor: closing thread from my side. Will follow up in postmortem channel.
incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: elkwood-prod tail latency mitigated by bespoke scheduler override. Follow-up: create RFC for per-tenant scheduler by 2024-08-05.
